text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Debut race. Symboli Kris S 
was calm as usual. However, just how heavy 
a toll the actual race would take on her 
remained unknown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, who had invited her to the 
academy, along with Tanino Gimlet from her 
class, had also come to watch. It was 
finally time for Symboli Kris S's debut 
race!
